title: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2610.27628v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped language models can run more iterations at test time, but additional iterations need not help them solve longer problems. For sequential state tracking, final-answer supervision does not specify how far each iteration should advance, and repeated updates can change the scale of the recurrent state. We introduce \textbf{Progress-Aligned Recurrence (PAR)}, which trains the prediction at iteration $k$ to match the state after the first $k$ operations and rescales recurrent states to their first-iteration norms. On swap-$S_5$, a Qwen2.5-0.5B model trained on at most 32 moves achieves 95.5\% mean full-state accuracy at 512 moves, or $16\times$ the training length, compared with 55.7\% reported for RLT and 0.8\% for explicit chain of thought on the same backbone. translated_title: PAR：用于状态跟踪长度泛化的进度对齐循环方法
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型可以在测试时运行更多迭代，但额外的迭代并不一定能帮助它们解决更长的题目。对于序列状态跟踪任务，最终答案的监督信号并未规定每次迭代应当推进多远，而且反复更新可能改变循环状态的尺度。我们提出了进度对齐循环（PAR），该方法训练第 k 次迭代的预测去匹配前 k 次操作之后的状态，并将循环状态重新缩放到其第一次迭代的范数。在 swap-S5 任务上，一个仅在最多 32 步数据上训练的 Qwen2.5-0.5B 模型，在 512 步（即训练长度的 16 倍）时达到了 95.5% 的平均全状态准确率；相比之下，在同一骨干网络上，RLT 报告的准确率为 55.7%，显式思维链仅为 0.8%。受控的 S5 消融实验表明，移除范数锚定会将外推倍数从 16 倍降至 2.2 倍以下，而若用其他目标替换进度对齐目标（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出进度对齐循环（PAR）训练方法，通过让第 k 次迭代的预测对齐前 k 步操作后的状态并将循环状态范数锚定到首次迭代，使 Qwen2.5-0.5B 在 swap-S5 状态跟踪任务上实现 16 倍于训练长度的外推泛化（512 步时准确率达 95.5%）。
en_tdlr: PAR (Progress-Aligned Recurrence) trains each iteration's prediction to match the state after the corresponding number of operations and anchors recurrent state norms to their first-iteration values, enabling a Qwen2.5-0.5B model to generalize 16× beyond its training length on swap-S5 state tracking with 95.5% accuracy at 512 moves.
